propositions: Five experiment artifact files cited in merged code (criteria_routing.json, closed tickets) exist only as untracked working-tree state and are not committed on origin/main, creating dangling citation references and broken provenance trails.

The calibration harness, calibration report, escaped-bug analysis harness, gap analysis report, and parity oracle prototype represent deliverables from three closed tickets (cranial-goodly-seahog, restoring-shallow-blobfish) and are the empirical basis for design decisions in active code (topaz-blubbery-mice).

Landing five static analysis artifacts into docs/experiments/ (an established peer of 30+ similar investigation files, outside packaged wheel and linting) is docs-only, runtime-inert, and poses no CI or behavioral risk.

After landing, criteria_routing.json comments referencing docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py resolve to a real file on main and the complete provenance audit trail becomes inspectable from the repo.
